overview_media.html_body:
Pull in videos, PDFs, and voice notes to write on-brand scripts, posts, and emails on a visual canvas

Bring all your sources into one place

  • Drag and drop YouTube videos, TikToks, IG Reels, PDFs, images, and voice notes directly onto your board
  • Connect websites and documents so Poppy AI can pull insights without you copying and pasting anything
  • Organize everything on a persistent visual canvas that holds your sources, notes, and AI outputs together

Write faster without losing your voice

  • Chat with ChatGPT and Claude in the same workspace without switching tabs or losing your thread
  • Generate scripts, posts, and emails directly from the sources on your board—not from a blank prompt
  • Let Poppy AI learn your style so every output sounds like you wrote it, not a language model

Summarize, analyze, and steal angles

  • Summarize hours of video and podcast content by asking Poppy AI exactly what you need to know
  • Analyze competitor content, websites, and documents to pull angles, hooks, and insights for campaigns
  • Extract key takeaways from any source without watching, reading, or listening to the whole thing

Plan and structure your content

  • Build mind maps to brainstorm narratives and campaign structures before you start writing
  • Turn connected nodes into outlines, scripts, and tasks without leaving the canvas
  • See all your assets and ideas in one view, so nothing falls through the cracks

posts.title: Why we built this AI tool…
posts.message:
Hey Sumo-lings!

Me and my co-founder Naz have ADHD and are neurodivergent (aka neuro spicy haha).

We go down rabbit holes, research things forever, and often tend to procrastinate as soon as it's time to turn our idea into action. (let's be real the idea part of it is more fun anyway 😂)

I've been using ChatGPT and Claude since literally the minute they came out and find it insane that majority of the people still don't know or don't use AI to help them in their day to day. Just walking around being 20 IQ points lower for no absolute reason is diabolical work in my opinion.

But I hate the fact that all AI tools are linear as in they go from top to bottom. Like a book. I've always felt so constrained using them like I'm in a strait jacket.

I wanted an experience that felt more like a choose your own adventure video game. An experience where I felt free in the way I could speak to the AI to have it work with me. I could talk to it through voice or text or an image or even a video. Somewhere I could visually stitch together all my thoughts and have AI make meaning out of it.

I wanted to be able to SEE all the knowledge it had at any given point. Something that didn't hallucinate or forget my conversation every few minutes.

Another problem I had was as a content creator and a copywriter whenever I had to write something I HATED sitting there looking at an empty blinking cursor on GOOGLE DOCS or constantly switching between chrome tabs to look at ChatGPT (uninspiring linear text blob) back to Google Docs (another uninspiring linear text blob).

I wanted to be able to throw all my research together and then have the AI write for me in my own voice. What I hated about regular ChatGPT was that I couldn't do that. It would always write me something cringy in a voice that never feels like my own.

We built this because our brain thinks non-linearly. Our thoughts are a chaotic mess. We needed something to slobber our thoughts all over.

Then use AI to stitch it together and make meaning out of it.

And ultimately to produce real world published work like emails that get 100k+ opens and videos that get millions of views. Doing it in a way that saves us 100's of hours and leaves us feeling inspired for doing more work.

-Qazi

faqs.question: What is Poppy AI and what are its main features?
faqs.answer: Poppy AI is a proactive AI assistant designed to help organize your digital life by integrating various services such as email, calendar, and messaging into a single dashboard. It offers features like proactive suggestions based on your schedule and location, the ability to connect with services like Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Gmail, Outlook, iCloud Mail, Apple Health, Reminders, Contacts, iMessage, WhatsApp, Uber, and Instacart, and the capability to handle multiple content types including YouTube videos, PDFs, voice notes, and images.

faqs.question: How do I get started with Poppy AI?
faqs.answer: To get started with Poppy AI, you can sign up on their official website. Once registered, you can connect various services like your email, calendar, and messaging apps to Poppy. The platform provides a visual canvas where you can drag in content such as YouTube videos, articles, PDFs, and voice notes, organizing them into groups for the AI to process simultaneously.

faqs.question: What AI models does Poppy AI support, and how do I choose the right one?
faqs.answer: Poppy AI supports multiple AI models, each with different content limits and strengths. For instance, GPT-5 mini is suitable for quick questions, while other models may be better for analyzing extensive documents. It's important to choose the model based on your specific task to avoid exceeding token limits and encountering errors.

faqs.question: How does Poppy AI handle user data and privacy?
faqs.answer: Poppy AI encrypts user data when stored in its database and has a zero-retention policy enabled when using cloud-based large language models for its suggestions. The company aims to transition to using local, on-device AI models as technology advances to further enhance privacy.

faqs.question: What is the Power User Upgrade in Poppy AI?
faqs.answer: The Power User Upgrade is a plan designed for serious Poppy AI users, offering 16,000 total monthly credits, full API access to connect Poppy to various platforms, a chatbot feature to share knowledge without sharing your account, and white-glove setup support during the launch period.

faqs.question: How are credits used in Poppy AI?
faqs.answer: Credits in Poppy AI are consumed when you interact with the AI through chats. Each plan comes with 2,000 base credits that reset to zero on the 1st of every month at 9 AM PST. Credits are not used for uploading files or organizing boards, only for AI interactions.

faqs.question: Can I integrate Poppy AI with other applications?
faqs.answer: Yes, Poppy AI offers full API access, allowing you to integrate it with various applications. This includes building custom chatbots, connecting to automation tools like Zapier and Make.com, integrating with messaging platforms like Telegram, and embedding Poppy's intelligence into your existing software.

faqs.question: What types of content can I add to Poppy AI boards?
faqs.answer: You can add various forms of content to Poppy AI boards, including YouTube videos, PDFs, voice notes, images, and more. This allows the AI to process and analyze multiple content types simultaneously, enhancing your productivity and content creation capabilities.

faqs.question: How does Poppy AI's proactive suggestion feature work?
faqs.answer: Poppy AI's proactive suggestion feature analyzes your connected services and data, such as your calendar and location, to provide timely recommendations. For example, if it detects a 30-minute gap in your schedule near a park, it might suggest taking a walk before your next appointment.

faqs.question: Is there a community or forum for Poppy AI users to provide feedback?
faqs.answer: Yes, Poppy AI has a feedback platform where users can submit feature requests, report issues, and engage with the community. The team reviews every idea and feedback submitted to improve the product.
